verdict.rationale: Hardware-accelerator support is a fair question for a local inference runtime like Ollama, so the axis applies. The evidence only mentions AMD ROCm GPUs and Apple silicon/MLX. Nothing shows a plugin mechanism or any support for TPUs, Gaudi or other specialized accelerators, and ROCm GPU support is an adjacent capability that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on specialized accelerators like TPUs or Gaudi through plugin support
